The '''Steelious system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Steelious]]. As customs were not strict on the planet, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] goods to and from the world was easy, and the [[Hervack Spaceport]] on Steelious was important for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] smuggling in the world's [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Royal" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|199|Karin, Baron}}</ref> a group of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] from Steelious traveled to the nearby planet [[Yarrv]] to open [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] negotiations with its ruling [[Noble/Legends|royal]] family.<ref name="Royal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Steelious [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2009]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
